answer: A concrete sybil defense is a funding-source surcharge: each new identity pays a registration deposit that doubles for every account already funded from the same wallet cluster. Ten clones then cost over a thousand times one account, and every deposit stays locked for 20 epochs. A farm's linked wallets form a reef on the funding graph that auditors can see, while an honest agent enters through its own inlet, pays the base deposit once, and crosses the bridge to full rewards.
